value.rationale: The natural classification problem is unit conjugation of algebra elements and ordinary conjugacy in the unit group. The theorem resolves all class sizes for every finite loopless quiver, not a narrow arbitrary slice. Orientation-blind complete spectra provably fail to detect finite global dimension for unbounded algebra dimensions, a structural limitation relevant to reconstruction from finite symmetry data. This is more than a small numerical improvement or a restatement of a commuting-pair average.
